items.docs: Returns the current logging levels for all named loggers configured in the Envoy instance. Logger names correspond to subsystems such as http, router, upstream, conn_handler, and others.

params.name: level
params.description: Set log level for all loggers simultaneously. One of trace, debug, info, warning, error, critical, or off.

params.name: paths
params.description: Set log level for a specific logger using logger_name:level format. Can be specified multiple times for multiple loggers.

items.docs: Dynamically changes the logging level for one or all loggers without restarting Envoy. Use the level query parameter to set all loggers or the paths parameter to set a specific logger at logger_name:level format.
